title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to augment the existing team and help accelerate delivery of a critical platform rewrite. This role will play a key part in shaping, building, and stabilizing a new integrated Salesforce-based platform, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partner teams.


Role Overview

The Senior Salesforce Developer will work alongside our partner teams, contributing hands-on to the design and development of the new integrated platform. This is a full-stack Salesforce role, with a strong emphasis on backend development, system integrations, and data modeling, as well as selective frontend work following established UI patterns and standards.


In this role, they will be expected to take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical decision-making, and uphold engineering best practices across a distributed development environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce backend components (Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, async processing) aligned with the ongoing platform rewrite.
  • Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions, including data modeling, integration patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Implement front-end functionality (LWC / Aura) by following existing design systems, UX patterns, and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven patterns where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with distributed teams, including India-based Salesforce developers and the Brazil-based Astra team, ensuring alignment and consistent delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor less-experienced developers, and promote best practices across the codebase.
  • Ensure solutions meet high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Participate in our partner’s technical vetting, documentation, and formal code review processes.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement during the rewrite effort.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with deep expertise in Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working within established front-end frameworks.
  • Proven experience working on complex, large-scale Salesforce implementations or platform rewrites.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and migration initiatives (GCP preferred, but AWS/Azure acceptable).
  • Experience working in distributed or staff-augmentation teams, collaborating across time zones and cultures.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Nearshore location preferred (Brazil, Mexico, Costa Rica) to ensure time-zone alignment.
  • Ability to successfully pass a full technical interview and live coding assessment.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Flutter or Go, which may be relevant for future product initiatives.
  • Experience with video/audio streaming applications or real-time collaboration platforms.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps tooling.
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architecture Designer) are a plus.


Why Join:

  • Work on a high-impact, end-to-end platform rewrite with a clearly defined launch timeline.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and technical leaders in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • Opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices on a mission-critical system.
  • Fully remote, nearshore-friendly role with potential for long-term engagement and growth.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on a high-impact, mission-critical platform alongside senior engineers in a fully remote, collaborative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.

*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

  • Partições

  • Prometheus

  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares

  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance

  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

title: Data Pipeline Engineer

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Pipeline Engineer to join our dynamic Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimizing for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Hired individuals will play a crucial role in helping to shape our ETL strategy and be part of a rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, planning, and implementing best practices that optimize data pipeline performance and reliability across our organization. You will work cross-functionally with all of our product teams to ensure smooth, efficient, and scalable pipelines. This position is ideal for someone who loves tackling complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on problem-solving, and loves the fast-paced environment where they can make a big impact.


As Our Data Engineer, You Will:

  • Report directly to the Director of Data Engineering, who will provide significant, hands-on training on cutting-edge data tools and techniques.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using PySpark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL tooling.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, or in other technical functions.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas .
  • You have a great understanding of working with data, orchestration tools, and data pipelines.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind different data ingestion and delivery strategies.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or equivalent.


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner

AWS-Python Production Support Engineer

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

title: Founding Application Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
ABOUT VOX

VOX is an Agentic Market Research platform that is Introducing a new model in Market Research. We’re turning Buyer-Sourced Insights into Real-Time Revenue, directly tackling the critical need for precise, timely, and relevant buyer data.


Our solution moves beyond traditional methods by utilizing human-led research powered by AI to provide real-time, human-validated insights.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own and scale VOX’s engineering organization as we enter our next phase of growth. As a founding engineer, you’ll define the technical vision, architect the core product, and partner closely with leadership to build an AI-native platform—leveraging agentic AI systems to scale subject-matter expertise.


This role is ideal for someone excited to build from zero to one, operate with high ownership, and shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architect and Build

  • Design and implement VOX’s initial product architecture and tech stack from scratch.
  • Build and iterate on MVPs with a strong bias toward speed, learning, and scalability.
  • Architect AI-first systems, including agent-based workflows that reason, plan, and act autonomously.


Agentic AI Development

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI systems (e.g., LLM-powered agents, tool-using agents, multi-agent workflows).
  • Integrate AI agents with product features such as expert reasoning, decision support, orchestration, and automation.
  • Evaluate and optimize models, prompts, tools, and feedback loops for reliability, performance, and cost.


Full-Stack Development

  • Work across the full stack—frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Build APIs, services, and data pipelines that support AI-driven workflows and real-time interactions.


Product & Technical Strategy

  • Collaborate closely with founders and early customers to define product requirements and roadmap.
  • Translate ambiguous problems into shipped features, iterating rapidly based on real-world feedback.
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, quality, and scalability in an early-stage environment.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Technical Expertise

  • Strong software engineering background with proficiency in languages such as Python and JavaScript.
  • Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML tooling (e.g., LLM APIs, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).


Agentic AI & Systems Thinking

  • Hands-on experience building or experimenting with agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong understanding of system design, reliability, and failure modes in AI-driven products.
  • Ability to reason about trade-offs in model selection, latency, cost, and accuracy.


Problem-Solving & Product Mindset

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  • Strong product intuition with a deep focus on user experience and business impact.


Communication & Ownership

  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • High degree of ownership, autonomy, and adaptability in a fast-moving startup environment.



* Competitive base salary plus meaningful equity.

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Document Controller
description:
Company Brief :


At Cyient, we are driven by a singular purpose—to improve the daily lives of people around the world. Whether it’s enabling a quieter flight, a safer train journey, a more affordable medical device, or a faster internet connection, our unwavering focus is on creating meaningful impact through innovation.

We are a trusted provider of engineering, manufacturing, and asset & operations management services, partnering with industry leaders across the globe to solve their complex challenges. With over 16,000 employees across 20+ countries, we support 12 key industries, including Aerospace, Rail Transportation, Power Generation, Communications, and Medical Technology. With a strong track record of growth and profitability, we remain deeply committed to building a sustainable future—actively investing in education and inclusive growth initiatives within the communities we operate in.


Job Description:

The Document Controller will manage and maintain project documentation to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with organizational and industry standards. This role supports engineering and project management teams by organizing, tracking, and safeguarding technical and commercial documents across the project lifecycle.


Job Responsibilities:


  • Establish and maintain document control systems (EDMS/DMS) for projects and operations.
  • Classify, index, and file documents (electronic and hard copy) with accurate metadata/attributes.
  • Monitor document workflows to ensure timely review, approval, and controlled distribution.
  • Maintain strict version control; ensure only current documents are in circulation.
  • Prepare and process transmittals; uphold document numbering procedures and naming conventions.
  • Coordinate submissions with internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Perform quality checks on deliverables (e.g., searchable PDFs, correct titles, revisions, attributes).
  • Generate regular status reports, registers, and KPI dashboards for document compliance.
  • Support audits and adhere to company QMS (ISO 9001)
  • Drive continuous improvement—cleanup duplicates/irrelevant files, optimize indexing and retrieval.


Required Attributes :

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in document control/records management in Oil & Gas/Offshore Drilling/EPC/EPCm industries.
  • Hands-on with EDMS/DMS platforms (ACONEX, Oracle UNIFIER, SharePoint Online, eRoom, Meridian).Experience with OpenText’ is preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and collaboration tools (Teams).
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation (e.g., P&IDs, PFLOW, vendor drawings, data books, specifications).
  • Strong attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to meet tight deadlines.

title: Senior Tech Sourcer
description:
Senior Tech Sourcer


Summary

We’re looking for an experienced Tech Sourcer to join Kake’s internal team and help build our sourcing function from the ground up. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing and executing sourcing strategies for technical roles, partnering closely with recruiters, and building strong talent pipelines. If you enjoy deep sourcing, proactive outreach, and shaping scalable processes, we’d love to hear from you.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with recruiters during role kick-offs to align on hiring needs, must-haves, dealbreakers, and sourcing strategy.
  • Own end-to-end technical sourcing for new roles, building and maintaining strong candidate pipelines.
  • Design and execute sourcing strategies using Boolean search, headhunting, talent mapping, and targeted company research.
  • Create tailored outreach messages to attract and engage high-quality technical candidates.
  • Conduct initial profile and pre-screening assessments, identifying fit, gaps, and potential risks early in the process.
  • Manage sourced candidates in the ATS, ensuring accurate tracking, stage updates, and smooth handoff to recruiters.
  • Maintain consistent communication with candidates, supporting scheduling and follow-ups when needed.
  • Contribute to building sourcing processes, best practices, and documentation as the function scales.


Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical sourcing or talent sourcing roles.
  • Strong experience sourcing for technical profiles across different stacks and seniority levels.
  • Proven ability to build pipelines from scratch using proactive sourcing techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, and ATS tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.


Nice to Have

  • Experience helping to build or scale a sourcing function.
  • Familiarity with market mapping and talent intelligence.
  • Experience working closely with recruiters in high-growth environments.


Other Traits

  • Proactive and curious, with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder partnership skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement in sourcing strategies and processes.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.The icing on the Kake:


  • Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.
  • Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.
  • Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.
  • Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Product Owner - Consultor(a) Senior
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por liderar a condução de projetos e iniciativas ágeis de ponta a ponta, desde a definição das histórias e priorização do backlog até o acompanhamento da entrega final, assegurando a qualidade e integridade conceitual das entregas. Atua garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e técnica para assegurar que as entregas estejam alinhadas ao escopo definido e aos objetivos da empresa. Além disso, mantém as práticas Scrum, apoia os outros papéis e garante comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads, atuando como educador para assegurar o respeito aos valores e metodologia ágil.

Principais atividades

  • Apoiar a gestão de projetos de lançamento de novas ofertas considerando atividades E2E, desde a solicitação do gerente de produto até o delivery técnico;
  • Definir a visão do produto, seu roadmap e oportunidades de crescimento com os diversos stakeholders;
  • Construir escopo junto com Líder de Produto, atuando no processo de elaboração de user stories garantindo requisitos necessários e alinhamento de expectativas junto às áreas de negócio;
  • Liderar grupos multidisciplinares para garantir a correta especificação do produto, ajudando na análise e negociação de impactos diretamente com as áreas de negócio;
  • Desafiar as áreas de negócio acerca de features de produtos, processos ou regras;
  • Traduzir a estratégia de negócios para o time técnico, garantindo o entendimento dos requisitos;
  • Negociar escopos prioritários com foco na estratégia de negócios, discutindo trade-offs estratégicos;
  • Validar refinamentos técnicos garantindo aderência ao escopo solicitado;
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis de alta transversalidade (diversas esteiras/sprints de desenvolvimento), centralizando decisões estratégicas;
  • Elaborar critérios de aceite para garantir alinhamento com demais times envolvidos, assegurando visão única de projeto/produto;
  • Realizar a validação e aprovação dos testes garantindo a qualidade da entrega e coordenar aprovação dos demais times envolvidos;
  • Acompanhar entrega e performance dos testes pós-produção para garantir funcionamento e velocidade na correção;
  • Apontar issues para serem endereçados pelo time técnico identificado;
  • Controlar cronograma e budget dos projetos garantindo aderência à estratégia;
  • Manter um olhar atento, crítico e propositivo durante todas as etapas do projeto, utilizando dados, aprendizados e feedbacks para monitorar a aderência ao processo e propor melhorias contínuas de forma assertiva;
  • Garantir a manutenção das práticas Scrum, apoiar os papéis envolvidos e manter a comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads;
  • Atuar como educador para assegurar que todos os participantes conheçam e respeitem os princípios e valores do Scrum.

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

• Experiência como Product Owner, Project Manager ou Scrum Master com atuação prática em projetos ágeis;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de backlog, elaboração de histórias e releases;

• Capacidade de atuar com diferentes stakeholders e áreas técnicas, negociando escopos e prazos;

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:

Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.

Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio

Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;

Escolaridade mínima:

  • Ensino médio técnico completo

Qualificação A: antes do embarque:

  • Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
  • Well Control IWCF – Level 3
  • Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Supervisor (a) Responsabilidade Social
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Missão do cargo:

Responsável por supervisionar as atividades da área de Responsabilidade Social, garantindo a qualidade dos serviços prestados, o cumprimento da legislação aplicável e a execução dos projetos sociais alinhados ao planejamento estratégico da unidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar as atividades da equipe, assegurando qualidade e desempenho.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e propor planos de ação.
  • Conduzir interlocução com lideranças comunitárias, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos do projeto.
  • Garantir a execução das atividades conforme planejamento estratégico da área.
  • Colaborar na elaboração do planejamento estratégico de Responsabilidade Social.
  • Controlar o direcionamento da atuação social da unidade conforme objetivos estratégicos.
  • Supervisionar procedimentos da pasta social do Programa Interage e gestão da legislação aplicável.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação de Responsabilidade Social.
  • Supervisionar a execução de projetos sociais e acompanhar projetos incentivados.
  • Direcionar atividades de relacionamento com populações em situação de vulnerabilidade.
  • Participar de processos de recrutamento e seleção da equipe, quando necessário.
  • Contribuir na definição de programas de treinamento e reciclagem profissional.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais solicitados pela gerência.
  • Garantir conservação e limpeza dos equipamentos de trabalho.
  • Cumprir normas e procedimentos internos.
  • Conduzir veículos utilizados nas atividades de forma segura.
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de saúde, segurança e uso adequado de EPIs.
  • Comprometer-se com as áreas de Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo (preferencialmente em áreas relacionadas à Responsabilidade Social, Administração ou Gestão de Projetos).
  • Experiência: Atuação anterior em supervisão de equipes e projetos sociais.
  • Conhecimentos: Legislação de Responsabilidade Social, gestão de projetos, planejamento estratégico.
  • Habilidades: Liderança, comunicação, organização, tomada de decisão.

Informações adicionais:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:
O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é:
Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:
Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.
Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

description:
Resumo da função:
Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.
Responsabilidades:
Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio
Exigências do Cargo:
Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;
Escolaridade mínima:
Ensino médio técnico completo
Qualificação A: antes do embarque:
Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
Well Control IWCF – Level 3
Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

Analyze profit and loss (P&L) statements

Accurate OPEX recharges
P&L review
Profit split

Reconcile the local ERP system (TOTVS) with the Group ERP system (Dynamics Business Central)
Assist in setting up finance procedures for accounting teams and external accounting firms
Liaise with the Commercial team
Liaise with and provide reporting to auditors

Map, restructure, and implement new processes to improve organization, workflow, and automation within the department

Strong experience in auditing small and mid-sized businesses or as a Financial Controller.
Strong knowledge of local Brazilian taxes and reporting requirements.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
Strong ability to maintain a high-level overview while being hands-on and detail-oriented
Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail
Team player with strong collaboration skills
Fluent in English and Spanish

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You
You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.
You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you're curious about AI/ML integrations even if you're not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
(If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.
Additional Information
Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.
Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

title: Product Owner - Consultor(a) Senior
description:
Descrição do perfil
Responsável por liderar a condução de projetos e iniciativas ágeis de ponta a ponta, desde a definição das histórias e priorização do backlog até o acompanhamento da entrega final, assegurando a qualidade e integridade conceitual das entregas. Atua garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e técnica para assegurar que as entregas estejam alinhadas ao escopo definido e aos objetivos da empresa. Além disso, mantém as práticas Scrum, apoia os outros papéis e garante comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads, atuando como educador para assegurar o respeito aos valores e metodologia ágil.
Principais atividades
Apoiar a gestão de projetos de lançamento de novas ofertas considerando atividades E2E, desde a solicitação do gerente de produto até o delivery técnico;
Definir a visão do produto, seu roadmap e oportunidades de crescimento com os diversos stakeholders;
Construir escopo junto com Líder de Produto, atuando no processo de elaboração de user stories garantindo requisitos necessários e alinhamento de expectativas junto às áreas de negócio;
Liderar grupos multidisciplinares para garantir a correta especificação do produto, ajudando na análise e negociação de impactos diretamente com as áreas de negócio;
Desafiar as áreas de negócio acerca de features de produtos, processos ou regras;
Traduzir a estratégia de negócios para o time técnico, garantindo o entendimento dos requisitos;
Negociar escopos prioritários com foco na estratégia de negócios, discutindo trade-offs estratégicos;
Validar refinamentos técnicos garantindo aderência ao escopo solicitado;
Conduzir cerimônias ágeis de alta transversalidade (diversas esteiras/sprints de desenvolvimento), centralizando decisões estratégicas;
Elaborar critérios de aceite para garantir alinhamento com demais times envolvidos, assegurando visão única de projeto/produto;
Realizar a validação e aprovação dos testes garantindo a qualidade da entrega e coordenar aprovação dos demais times envolvidos;
Acompanhar entrega e performance dos testes pós-produção para garantir funcionamento e velocidade na correção;
Apontar issues para serem endereçados pelo time técnico identificado;
Controlar cronograma e budget dos projetos garantindo aderência à estratégia;
Manter um olhar atento, crítico e propositivo durante todas as etapas do projeto, utilizando dados, aprendizados e feedbacks para monitorar a aderência ao processo e propor melhorias contínuas de forma assertiva;
Garantir a manutenção das práticas Scrum, apoiar os papéis envolvidos e manter a comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads;
Atuar como educador para assegurar que todos os participantes conheçam e respeitem os princípios e valores do Scrum.
Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência como Product Owner, Project Manager ou Scrum Master com atuação prática em projetos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de backlog, elaboração de histórias e releases;
  • Capacidade de atuar com diferentes stakeholders e áreas técnicas, negociando escopos e prazos;
  • Habilidade para escrever e organizar user stories, critérios de aceite e planos de entrega;
  • Conhecimento em rituais ágeis e na condução de cerimônias com múltiplas esteiras ou times;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com forte senso de responsabilidade pela entrega de valor;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure, Jira, Monday;
  • Boa capacidade de articulação, visão crítica e habilidade de propor melhorias processuais com base em experiência prática;
  • Inglês avançado é obrigatório;
  • Graduação Completa em Administração/Marketing/Tecnologia/Engenharia.
    Na TIM, o seu bem-estar é o nosso bem-estar, por isso o programa Conexão Bem + Estar tem o propósito de fortalecer o cuidado genuíno da TIM com o TIMe e suas famílias, por meio de iniciativas práticas em diversas frentes para todos e todas estarem sempre bem, na vida pessoal e profissional.

description:

Experiência como recepcionista

title: Supervisor (a) Responsabilidade Social
description:
A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Missão do cargo:
Responsável por supervisionar as atividades da área de Responsabilidade Social, garantindo a qualidade dos serviços prestados, o cumprimento da legislação aplicável e a execução dos projetos sociais alinhados ao planejamento estratégico da unidade.
Principais Responsabilidades
Supervisionar as atividades da equipe, assegurando qualidade e desempenho.
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e propor planos de ação.
Conduzir interlocução com lideranças comunitárias, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos do projeto.
Garantir a execução das atividades conforme planejamento estratégico da área.
Colaborar na elaboração do planejamento estratégico de Responsabilidade Social.
Controlar o direcionamento da atuação social da unidade conforme objetivos estratégicos.
Supervisionar procedimentos da pasta social do Programa Interage e gestão da legislação aplicável.
Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação de Responsabilidade Social.
Supervisionar a execução de projetos sociais e acompanhar projetos incentivados.
Direcionar atividades de relacionamento com populações em situação de vulnerabilidade.
Participar de processos de recrutamento e seleção da equipe, quando necessário.
Contribuir na definição de programas de treinamento e reciclagem profissional.
Elaborar relatórios gerenciais solicitados pela gerência.
Garantir conservação e limpeza dos equipamentos de trabalho.
Cumprir normas e procedimentos internos.
Conduzir veículos utilizados nas atividades de forma segura.
Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de saúde, segurança e uso adequado de EPIs.
Comprometer-se com as áreas de Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho.
Executar outras tarefas correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato.
Requisitos
Formação:
Ensino superior completo (preferencialmente em áreas relacionadas à Responsabilidade Social, Administração ou Gestão de Projetos).
Experiência:
Atuação anterior em supervisão de equipes e projetos sociais.
Conhecimentos:
Legislação de Responsabilidade Social, gestão de projetos, planejamento estratégico.
Habilidades:
Liderança, comunicação, organização, tomada de decisão.
Informações adicionais:
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!
A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.
Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG's software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience
Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we're reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you'll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us
Innovators in Simulation Technology
CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Assistente de Sustentabilidade - Vaga exclusiva para PcD
description:
ALLOS
é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a
Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls
, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Apoiar a automação de processos, contribuindo para aprimorar sistemas existentes, integrações e ferramentas internas, com foco em eficiência;
Atuar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, transitando por diversas áreas da empresa para coletar informações, alinhar entregas e garantir coerência dos dados reportados;
